title: Asset Manifest
description: Inventory of generated/sourced assets produced by the Asset Generator.

type.description: Asset type. Standard types: image, video, audio, narration, music, sfx. Romance pipeline extensions: character_reference, scene_image, narration_audio, dialogue_audio, section_audio, music_track, sfx_track.

path.description: Relative or absolute path to the asset file

generation_summary.description: Brief summary of how the asset was generated or sourced

original_url.description: Source URL if downloaded from a stock service

negative_prompt.description: Negative prompt used for generation (romance pipeline)

character_id.description: Character ID for character_reference assets (romance pipeline)

section_id.description: Script section ID for narration/dialogue assets (romance pipeline)

segment_index.description: Index within a section for multi-segment narration (romance pipeline)

speaker.description: Speaker ID for dialogue assets (romance pipeline)

text.description: Text content for narration/dialogue assets (romance pipeline)

start_seconds.description: Start time in the final video (romance pipeline)

end_seconds.description: End time in the final video (romance pipeline)

cue.description: Music cue name for music_track assets (romance pipeline)

effect.description: SFX effect name for sfx_track assets (romance pipeline)
